[[Calais, Maine|Calais]]) ==Analysis== Despite the divided field, Baldacci still finished nearly eight points ahead of his nearest challenger, Woodcock. Merrill took an impressive 21% of the vote, and carried the municipalities of [[Glenwood Plantation, Maine|Glenwood Plantation]], [[Hope, Maine|Hope]], [[Milton, Maine|Milton]], [[Seboeis Plantation, Maine|Seboeis Plantation]], [[Stow, Maine|Stow]], [[The Forks, Maine|The Forks]], and [[Union, Maine|Union]]. Additionally, the municipalities of [[Carroll Plantation, Maine|Carroll Plantation]], [[Dennysville, Maine|Dennysville]], [[Wade, Maine|Wade]], and [[Westmanland, Maine|Westmanland]] finished as exact ties between Baldacci and Woodcock, while the municipality of [[Highland Plantation, Maine|Highland Plantation]] finished as an exact tie between Baldacci and LaMarche, the municipality of [[Webster Plantation, Maine|Webster Plantation]] finished as an exact tie between Baldacci and Merrill, and the municipality of [[Nashville Plantation, Maine|Nashville Plantation]] finished as an exact tie between Woodcock and Merrill. Despite LaMarche getting nearly 10% of the vote and slightly improving on [[Jonathan Carter (politician)|Jonathan Carter's]] vote percentage and vote total four years earlier, both of which were all-time highs for the [[Maine Green Independent Party]], the 2006 election remains the most recent time the Greens ran a candidate for governor. ==See also== * [[2006 United States gubernatorial elections]] * [[2006 United States Senate election in Maine]] ==Notes== {{notelist}} ==References== {{reflist}} ==External links== '''Official campaign websites (archived)''' * [https://web.archive.org/web/20061004030617/http://baldacciforgovernor.com/ John Baldacci for Governor] * [https://web.archive.org/web/20060823061058/http://www.woodcockforgovernor.com/ Chandler Woodcock for Governor] * [https://web.archive.org/web/20060826120702/http://www.candidatebruce.com/ Bruce Fleming for Governor] * [https://web.archive.org/web/20060824071717/http://www.hammer2006.politicalgateway.com/cand.php?id=426 Alex Hammer for Governor] * [https://web.archive.org/web/20061004034045/http://barbaramerrill.com/ Barbara Merrill for Governor] * [https://web.archive.org/web/20060905060010/http://www.jonesforgovernor.org/ David Jones for Governor] {{Maine gubernatorial elections|state=expanded}} {{2006 U.S. midterm elections}} {{US Third Party Election}} [[Category:2006 elections in Maine|Governor]] [[Category:Maine gubernatorial elections|2006]] [[Category:2006 United States gubernatorial elections|Maine]]
